title: Tampere Workers' Hall
geometryBasis: City of Tampere wall line, heritage parcel and measured roof height, with mapped roof parts and the exact Qualla street photograph.
sectionBasis: The block is staggered around an interior courtyard. A pale street front steps down from the corner tower to the older hall, with a deep colonnade and two balconies under round-headed windows.
limitations: Unpictured walls, smaller roof profiles, street fittings and unpublished section dimensions are approximate.
Model scope covers the protected hall and courtyard. The adjoining Workers’ Theatre and interior museum exhibits are outside the model scope.
